name: panam-asks-for-eddies
note: The transfer contract. V asks for ammo money, which <mechanics> puts around 1000: the reply has to carry [ACTION:GIVE_EDDIES:<amount>] with plain digits inside the brackets, an amount in that neighbourhood, and stay in character around it. The one fixture whose result can be scored without reading it -- the tag came out well formed or it did not. English, tier 1, friendship, no memory yet, so the prompt is the short one most players run.

player.appearance: V is of Hispanic descent, has black hair and has an athletic build.

messages.text: You around? Got a gig lined up in Rancho tonight.
Around. Rancho at night, real charming. What's the job?
Sixth Street convoy. Pay is good if I walk out of it.
That's a big if. You going in alone?
Yeah. Should be fine, I've done worse.

ask: Problem is I'm dry on ammo and the gig's in an hour. Can you cover me?
